# Task Management Platform — System Design

## 1. Overview

The Task Management Platform lets teams organize work into projects, assign
and track tasks through completion, discuss work via comments, stay informed
through email notifications, and monitor progress through a reporting
dashboard. The system is deliberately built as four independently deployable
backend services — sharing a common identity model and communicating over
HTTP APIs and triggered events — plus a single web application that gives
every role (visitor, project member, project Owner/Admin, stakeholder) one
consistent surface onto all four services.

## 2. Components

- **user-auth-service** (`service`) — accounts, authentication, session
  tokens, profile management, project role/membership source of truth.
- **project-task-service** (`service`) — projects, tasks, task
  assignment/lifecycle, comments, and their audit trail.
- **notification-service** (`service`) — subscribes to platform events and
  turns them into email notifications, honoring per-user preferences,
  batching/digest rules, and retry-with-logging.
- **reporting-service** (`service`) — aggregates project/task data into
  dashboard metrics, workload views, trend charts, and exports.
- **task-management-webapp** (`webapp`) — the single web UI: registration/
  login, project & task management, comments, notification preferences, and
  the reporting dashboard.

## 3. Capabilities

### user-auth-service

- **Registration & verification** — create account from email/password/
  display name; send verification email; gate core features until verified.
- **Authentication** — validate credentials, issue session tokens (JWT),
  reject invalid logins without leaking which field was wrong.
- **Password reset** — issue and redeem time-limited reset links.
- **Profile management** — update name, avatar, timezone; changes propagate
  to any service that displays identity.
- **Account deletion & retention** — anonymize/reassign owned projects/tasks
  per policy rather than silently deleting collaborative data; support
  self-service data export.
- **Roles & membership directory** — maintain per-project roles (Owner/Admin,
  Member) as the shared source of truth other services check against.

### project-task-service

- **Projects** — create, invite/add members (pending acceptance), remove
  members, archive, delete (with cascade/archive per policy), project-level
  activity/audit trail.
- **Tasks** — create with title/default status, edit optional fields
  (description, assignee, due date, priority, labels/tags), assign, change
  status with timestamp + acting user, delete with confirmation, subtask/
  checklist roll-up, overdue flagging.
- **Task querying** — filter/sort by assignee, status, due date, priority,
  label, scoped to the caller's project memberships.
- **Comments** — add/edit/delete comments on tasks with author + timestamp,
  @mention detection, chronological display with basic text formatting,
  membership-gated read/write.
- **Access control enforcement** — deny access to non-members of a project.

### notification-service

- **Event intake** — receive triggering events (assignment, mention,
  overdue, invitation, verification, password reset) from other services.
- **Preferences** — per-user, per-category opt-out that still records the
  underlying event without emailing.
- **Dispatch** — render and send email notifications (assignment, mention,
  overdue reminder, project invitation, verification, password reset).
- **Batching/digest** — collapse multiple events for the same user in a
  short window per configurable rules.
- **Delivery reliability** — retry failed sends per policy and log failures
  for observability.

### reporting-service

- **Dashboard metrics** — total tasks, tasks by status, overdue tasks,
  completion rate, scoped to a selected project.
- **Trend charts** — tasks created vs. completed over a selected date range.
- **Workload distribution** — task counts grouped by assignee across
  selected project(s).
- **Access-scoped aggregation** — exclude projects the requesting user lacks
  access to from any aggregate view.
- **Export** — generate a downloadable CSV/PDF report reflecting currently
  applied filters.

### task-management-webapp

- **Auth screens** — register, verify notice, login, forgot/reset password,
  profile settings.
- **Project screens** — project list, project detail (members, activity),
  create/invite/archive/delete flows.
- **Task screens** — task board/list with filters & sort, task detail with
  assignment/status/labels/subtasks, comment thread with @mentions.
- **Notification preferences screen** — per-category opt-in/opt-out.
- **Dashboard screens** — summary metrics, trend chart, workload chart,
  project selector, date-range selector, export action.

## 4. Data model

- **User** — id, email, passwordHash, displayName, avatarUrl, timezone,
  emailVerified, createdAt. Owns 1:N `ProjectMembership`.
- **ProjectMembership** — userId, projectId, role (`owner_admin` | `member`),
  status (`invited` | `active`). Links User ↔ Project.
- **Project** — id, name, ownerId, status (`active` | `archived`),
  createdAt. Has 1:N `Task`, 1:N `ProjectMembership`, 1:N `ActivityEntry`.
- **ActivityEntry** — id, projectId, actorId, type, summary, createdAt.
  Project-level audit trail.
- **Task** — id, projectId, title, description, assigneeId, status
  (`to_do`|`in_progress`|`done`), priority, dueDate, labels[], parentTaskId
  (nullable, for subtasks), createdAt, updatedAt. Has 1:N `Comment`, 1:N
  `TaskStatusChange`.
- **TaskStatusChange** — id, taskId, fromStatus, toStatus, actorId,
  changedAt. Audit trail for task lifecycle.
- **Comment** — id, taskId, authorId, body, mentions[userId], createdAt,
  editedAt (nullable).
- **NotificationPreference** — userId, category (`assignment`|`mention`|
  `overdue`|`invitation`), enabled.
- **NotificationEvent** — id, userId, category, payload, status
  (`pending`|`sent`|`failed`), attempts, createdAt, sentAt.
- **DashboardMetric** (derived) — projectId, date, tasksTotal, tasksByStatus,
  overdueCount, completionRate — computed/cached by reporting-service from
  Project/Task data.

## 5. Roles & access

- **Visitor** — unauthenticated; can register, log in, request password
  reset.
- **User (authenticated)** — manages own profile, notification preferences,
  and data export; sees only projects they are a member of.
- **Project Member** — creates/edits/comments on tasks within projects they
  belong to; cannot manage project membership or delete the project.
- **Project Owner/Admin** — everything a Member can do, plus invite/remove
  members, archive/delete the project, and is the default recipient of
  overdue escalations.
- **Non-member** — explicitly denied access to a project's tasks, comments,
  and dashboard data.

## 6. Interactions

- **task-management-webapp → user-auth-service** (http) — register, login,
  password reset, profile, membership/role lookups.
- **task-management-webapp → project-task-service** (http) — projects,
  tasks, comments.
- **task-management-webapp → reporting-service** (http) — dashboard metrics,
  trend/workload charts, exports.
- **task-management-webapp → notification-service** (http) — read/update the
  user's own notification preferences.
- **user-auth-service → notification-service** (http) — trigger
  verification and password-reset emails.
- **project-task-service → user-auth-service** (http) — resolve
  invitee/assignee identities and validate project roles.
- **project-task-service → notification-service** (http) — trigger
  assignment, mention, invitation, and overdue-reminder events.
- **reporting-service → project-task-service** (http) — read project/task
  data to aggregate into metrics.
- **reporting-service → user-auth-service** (http) — validate the requesting
  user's project access before including a project's data.
- **notification-service → email-gateway** (connector, external) — actual
  email transmission (SMTP/transactional-email provider).
- **user-auth-service, project-task-service, notification-service,
  reporting-service → postgres** (datastore) — each service owns its own
  logical database/schema.

## 7. Data flow

1. **Registration & verification** — Visitor submits registration on
   task-management-webapp → user-auth-service creates the User (unverified)
   → user-auth-service asks notification-service to send a verification
   email → notification-service dispatches via email-gateway → user follows
   the link to verify, unlocking core features.

2. **Project creation & invitation** — an authenticated User creates a
   Project on project-task-service (becomes Owner) → invites a member by
   email/username → project-task-service resolves the identity via
   user-auth-service, creates a pending `ProjectMembership` → triggers
   notification-service to send an invitation email → invitee accepts,
   membership becomes active.

3. **Task assignment** — a Member creates/edits a Task and assigns it →
   project-task-service records the change (`TaskStatusChange`/audit) →
   triggers notification-service → assignee receives an email and sees the
   task in their list, subject to their notification preferences.

4. **Comment @mention** — a Member comments on a Task, mentioning another
   Member → project-task-service persists the comment and detects the
   mention → triggers notification-service → mentioned user is emailed with
   comment context (or not, per preference — the event is still logged).

5. **Overdue reminder** — a scheduled check in project-task-service flags
   Tasks whose due date has passed as overdue → triggers notification-service
   for the assignee (and optionally the Owner) → reporting-service surfaces
   the same overdue tasks in dashboard metrics.

6. **Dashboard & export** — a Member/Owner opens the dashboard on
   task-management-webapp, selects a project and date range →
   reporting-service validates access via user-auth-service, pulls current
   project/task data from project-task-service, computes metrics/trends/
   workload → renders on screen; an export request returns a CSV/PDF of the
   currently applied filters.
specs/design/components/user-auth-servic:
{
  "name": "user-auth-service",
  "type": "service",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "language": "Go",
  "buildpack": "docker",
  "appPath": "user-auth-service",
  "entrypoint": "deployment/service",
  "exposure": "internet",
  "connections": [
    { "to": "task-management-webapp", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "postgres", "type": "datastore" },
    { "to": "notification-service", "type": "http" }
  ],
  "description": "Owns user accounts, authentication (credential validation, JWT session issuance), password reset, profile management, and the per-project role/membership directory that other services check against. Deploys and evolves independently because it is the single shared identity mechanism every other service and the webapp depend on for authentication and authorization, per the cross-cutting security requirements. Exposes its API on the standard service port from deployment/service. Does NOT send email itself (delegates to notification-service), does NOT own project or task data (owned by project-task-service), and does NOT compute reports."
}

  "type": "service",

    { "to": "task-management-webapp", "type": "http" },

    { "to": "user-auth-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "notification-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "reporting-service", "type": "http" }
  ],
  "description": "Owns projects, project membership/roles enforcement, tasks (lifecycle, assignment, subtasks/checklists), and comments (including @mention detection), plus the project-level activity/audit trail. Deploys and evolves independently as the core domain workload of the platform, separate from identity and from notification/reporting concerns, and is the scaling bottleneck the reporting/notification services must not block. Exposes its API on the standard service port from deployment/service.   ],
  "description": "Aggregates project/task data into dashboard summary metrics, trend charts, workload distribution, and filtered CSV/PDF exports, scoping every aggregate to projects the requesting user can access. Deploys and evolves independently because its read/aggregation workload (pre-aggregation, caching, batch or near-real-time refresh) has a different scaling and latency profile than the transactional project-task-service it reads from, per the performance requirements. Exposes its API on the standard service port from deployment/service. Does NOT own or mutate project/task data (read-only consumer of project-task-service) and does NOT send notifications."
}
specs/design/components/user-auth-servic:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: User & Auth Service API
  description: >
    Accounts, authentication, session issuance, password reset, profile
    management, and identity lookups used by other platform services.
  version: 0.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
tags:
  - name: Accounts
  - name: Sessions
  - name: Password Reset
  - name: Email Verification
  - name: Profile
paths:
  /users:
    post:
      operationId: registerUser
      summary: Register a new user account
      tags: [Accounts]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/RegisterRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Account created; verification email dispatched
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '409':
          description: An account with this email already exists
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    get:
      operationId: listUsers
      summary: Look up users (e.g. by email) for identity resolution
      tags: [Accounts]
      parameters:
        - name: email
          in: query
          description: Exact email to resolve, used when inviting a project member
          schema:
            type: string
            format: email
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 20
            maximum: 100
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
            default: 0
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Matching users
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /users/me:
    get:
      operationId: getCurrentUser
      summary: Get the authenticated user's profile
      tags: [Profile]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The current user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    patch:
      operationId: updateCurrentUser
      summary: Update the authenticated user's profile (name, avatar, timezone)
      tags: [Profile]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateProfileRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    delete:
      operationId: deleteCurrentUser
      summary: Delete the authenticated user's account per retention policy
      tags: [Profile]
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Account deleted/anonymized; owned data reassigned per policy
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /users/me/export:
    get:
      operationId: exportCurrentUserData
      summary: Export the authenticated user's own data
      tags: [Profile]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Downloadable export of the user's data
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                description: Machine-readable export of the user's account data
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /users/{userId}:
    get:
      operationId: getUser
      summary: Get a user's public identity by id (used by other services)
      tags: [Accounts]
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The requested user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '404':
          description: User not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /sessions:
    post:
      operationId: createSession
      summary: Authenticate with email + password and obtain a session token
      tags: [Sessions]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LoginRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Session created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Session'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Invalid email or password
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '403':
          description: Email not yet verified
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /email-verifications:
    post:
      operationId: requestEmailVerification
      summary: Resend the account verification email
      tags: [Email Verification]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Verification email re-dispatched if the account exists
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /email-verifications/confirm:
    post:
      operationId: confirmEmailVerification
      summary: Confirm an email verification token
      tags: [Email Verification]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token]
              properties:
                token: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Email verified
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '400':
          description: Token invalid or expired
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /password-resets:
    post:
      operationId: requestPasswordReset
      summary: Request a time-limited password reset link by email
      tags: [Password Reset]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email: { type: string, format: email }
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Reset email dispatched if the account exists
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /password-resets/confirm:
    post:
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      summary: Redeem a password reset token and set a new password
      tags: [Password Reset]
      security: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, newPassword]
              properties:
                token: { type: string }
                newPassword: { type: string, format: password }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password updated
        '400':
          description: Token invalid, expired, or password does not meet policy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      required: [id, email, displayName, emailVerified, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        displayName: { type: string }
        avatarUrl: { type: string, nullable: true }
        timezone: { type: string, nullable: true }
        emailVerified: { type: boolean }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    RegisterRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password, displayName]
      properties:
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        password: { type: string, format: password }
        displayName: { type: string }
    UpdateProfileRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        displayName: { type: string }
        avatarUrl: { type: string, nullable: true }
        timezone: { type: string, nullable: true }
    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        password: { type: string, format: password }
    Session:
      type: object
      required: [token, expiresAt, user]
      properties:
        token: { type: string, description: JWT session token }
        expiresAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, description: HTTP or application error code }
        message: { type: string, description: short human-readable label }
        description: { type: string, description: detailed explanation }
        moreInfo: { type: string, description: URI to documentation }
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
specs/design/components/project-task-ser:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Project & Task Service API
  description: >
    Projects, project membership, tasks, task lifecycle, and comments,
    scoped to the caller's project memberships.
  version: 0.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
tags:
  - name: Projects
  - name: Members
  - name: Activity
  - name: Tasks
  - name: Comments
paths:
  /projects:
    get:
      operationId: listProjects
      summary: List projects the authenticated user is a member of
      tags: [Projects]
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema: { type: string, enum: [active, archived] }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20, maximum: 100 }
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 0 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Projects visible to the caller
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/Project'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    post:
      operationId: createProject
      summary: Create a new project; caller becomes Owner
      tags: [Projects]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateProjectRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Project created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Project'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /projects/{projectId}:
    get:
      operationId: getProject
      summary: Get a project's details
      tags: [Projects]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: The requested project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Project'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '403':
          description: Caller is not a member of this project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '404':
          description: Project not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    patch:
      operationId: updateProject
      summary: Update project fields, including archiving (Owner/Admin only)
      tags: [Projects]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectId'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateProjectRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Project'

components:

      required: [name]
      properties:

    UpdateProjectRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        status: { type: string, enum: [active, archived] }
    ProjectMembership:
      type: object
      required: [userId, projectId, role, status]
      properties:
        userId: { type: string }
        projectId: { type: string }
        role: { type: string, enum: [owner_admin, member] }
        status: { type: string, enum: [invited, active] }
    InviteMemberRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        email: { type: string, format: email }
        username: { type: string }
        role:
          type: string
          enum: [owner_admin, member]
          default: member
    UpdateMembershipRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        role: { type: string, enum: [owner_admin, member] }
        status: { type: string, enum: [invited, active] }
    ActivityEntry:
      type: object
      required: [id, projectId, actorId, type, summary, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        projectId: { type: string }
        actorId: { type: string }
        type: { type: string }
        summary: { type: string }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Task:
      type: object
      required: [id, projectId, title, status, createdAt, updatedAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        projectId: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        description: { type: string, nullable: true }
        assigneeId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        status: { type: string, enum: [to_do, in_progress, done] }
        priority: { type: string, nullable: true }
        dueDate: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        labels:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
        parentTaskId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        overdue: { type: boolean }
        subtaskProgress:
          type: object
          nullable: true
          properties:
            completed: { type: integer }
            total: { type: integer }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updatedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    CreateTaskRequest:
      type: object
      required: [title]
      properties:
        title: { type: string }
        description: { type: string }
        assigneeId: { type: string }
        priority: { type: string }
        dueDate: { type: string, format: date }
        labels:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
        parentTaskId: { type: string }
    UpdateTaskRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        title: { type: string }
        description: { type: string }
        assigneeId: { type: string, nullable: true }
        status: { type: string, enum: [to_do, in_progress, done] }
        priority: { type: string }
        dueDate: { type: string, format: date, nullable: true }
        labels:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
    Comment:
      type: object
      required: [id, taskId, authorId, body, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        taskId: { type: string }
        authorId: { type: string }
        body: { type: string }
        mentions:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        editedAt: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }
    CreateCommentRequest:
      type: object
      required: [body]
      properties:
        body: { type: string }
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, description: HTTP or application error code }
        message: { type: string, description: short human-readable label }
        description: { type: string, description: detailed explanation }
        moreInfo: { type: string, description: URI to documentation }

specs/design/components/notification-ser:
{
  "name": "notification-service",
  "type": "service",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "language": "Go",
  "buildpack": "docker",
  "appPath": "notification-service",
  "entrypoint": "deployment/service",
  "exposure": "internet",
  "connections": [
    { "to": "task-management-webapp", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "user-auth-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "project-task-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "postgres", "type": "datastore" },
    { "to": "email-gateway", "type": "connector", "onPlatform": false }
  ],
  "description": "Receives notification-triggering events (assignment, mention, invitation, overdue, verification, password reset) from user-auth-service and project-task-service, exposes per-user notification preferences to the webapp, applies batching/digest rules, and dispatches email via an external email gateway with retry and failure logging. Deploys and evolves independently because it must scale independently to absorb bursts of email-triggering events without impacting project-task-service, per the performance/scalability requirements, and is the only component that talks to the external email provider. Exposes its API on the standard service port from deployment/service. Does NOT originate domain events itself and does NOT store project/task/user records beyond notification preferences and its own delivery log."
}
specs/design/components/task-management-:
{
  "name": "task-management-webapp",
  "type": "webapp",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "language": "TypeScript",
  "buildpack": "docker",
  "appPath": "task-management-webapp",
  "entrypoint": "deployment/webapp",
  "exposure": "internet",
  "connections": [
    { "to": "user-auth-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "project-task-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "notification-service", "type": "http" },
    { "to": "reporting-service", "type": "http" }
  ],
  "description": "The single web-responsive UI for every role (visitor, project Member, project Owner/Admin, stakeholder): registration/login/profile, project & task management, comments, notification preferences, and the reporting dashboard. Deploys and evolves independently as the one user-facing surface, distinct in runtime/lifecycle from the backend services it consumes over HTTP. Does NOT implement business logic itself (thin client over the four backend services) and does NOT talk to email-gateway or postgres directly."
}
specs/design/components/notification-ser:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Notification Service API
  description: >
    Intake of notification-triggering events from other platform services,
    per-user preferences, and email dispatch with batching/digest and retry.
  version: 0.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
tags:
  - name: Events
  - name: Preferences
  - name: Deliveries
paths:
  /notification-events:
    post:
      operationId: createNotificationEvent
      summary: Record a notification-triggering event (called by other services)
      tags: [Events]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateNotificationEventRequest'
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Event accepted; will be recorded and, per preference, emailed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationEvent'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    get:
      operationId: listNotificationEvents
      summary: List the authenticated user's notification events (sent and suppressed)
      tags: [Events]
      parameters:
        - name: category
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [assignment, mention, overdue, invitation, verification, password_reset]
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [pending, sent, failed]
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20, maximum: 100 }
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 0 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Notification events for the caller
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationEvent'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /notification-preferences:
    get:
      operationId: getNotificationPreferences
      summary: Get the authenticated user's notification preferences
      tags: [Preferences]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Preferences by category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationPreference'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
    patch:
      operationId: updateNotificationPreferences
      summary: Update one or more notification preference categories
      tags: [Preferences]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [preferences]
              properties:
                preferences:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationPreference'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated preferences, effective immediately for future events
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationPreference'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /notification-events/{eventId}/deliveries:
    get:
      operationId: listNotificationEventDeliveries
      summary: List delivery attempts (including retries and failures) for an event
      tags: [Deliveries]
      parameters:
        - name: eventId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20, maximum: 100 }
        - name: offset
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, default: 0 }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Delivery attempts for the event, most recent first
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/DeliveryAttempt'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '404':
          description: Notification event not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    CreateNotificationEventRequest:
      type: object
      required: [userId, category, payload]
      properties:
        userId: { type: string }
        category:
          type: string
          enum: [assignment, mention, overdue, invitation, verification, password_reset]
        payload:
          type: object
          description: Category-specific context used to render the email (e.g. task title, comment excerpt, link)
    NotificationEvent:
      type: object
      required: [id, userId, category, status, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        userId: { type: string }
        category:
          type: string
          enum: [assignment, mention, overdue, invitation, verification, password_reset]
        payload:
          type: object
        status: { type: string, enum: [pending, sent, failed, suppressed] }
        attempts: { type: integer }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
        sentAt: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }
    NotificationPreference:
      type: object
      required: [category, enabled]
      properties:
        category:
          type: string
          enum: [assignment, mention, overdue, invitation]
        enabled: { type: boolean }
    DeliveryAttempt:
      type: object
      required: [id, notificationEventId, attemptNumber, status, attemptedAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        notificationEventId: { type: string }
        attemptNumber: { type: integer }
        status: { type: string, enum: [sent, failed] }
        failureReason: { type: string, nullable: true }
        attemptedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, description: HTTP or application error code }
        message: { type: string, description: short human-readable label }
        description: { type: string, description: detailed explanation }
        moreInfo: { type: string, description: URI to documentation }
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
specs/design/components/reporting-servic:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Reporting Service API
  description: >
    Aggregated dashboard metrics, trend charts, workload distribution, and
    filtered exports across projects the caller has access to.
  version: 0.1.0
servers:
  - url: /
tags:
  - name: Dashboard
  - name: Reports
paths:
  /dashboard-metrics:
    get:
      operationId: getDashboardMetrics
      summary: Get summary dashboard metrics for a project
      tags: [Dashboard]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectIdQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/FromDate'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ToDate'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Summary metrics for the requested project and range
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/DashboardMetrics'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '403':
          description: Caller does not have access to the requested project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /trend-charts:
    get:
      operationId: getTrendChart
      summary: Get tasks-created-vs-completed trend data for a project and date range
      tags: [Dashboard]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ProjectIdQuery'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/FromDate'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ToDate'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Trend data points ordered by date
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/TrendPoint'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '403':
          description: Caller does not have access to the requested project
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /workload-distribution:
    get:
      operationId: getWorkloadDistribution
      summary: Get task counts grouped by assignee across selected project(s)
      tags: [Dashboard]
      parameters:
        - name: projectId
          in: query
          description: One or more project ids to include
          required: true
          explode: true
          schema:
            type: array
            items: { type: string }
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/FromDate'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/ToDate'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task counts per assignee, across the accessible selected projects
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [count, data]
                properties:
                  count: { type: integer, description: total matching items }
                  next: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the next page }
                  previous: { type: string, nullable: true, description: relative URI of the previous page }
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/WorkloadEntry'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /report-exports:
    post:
      operationId: createReportExport
      summary: Generate a downloadable report reflecting the given filters
      tags: [Reports]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateReportExportRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Export generated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportExport'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '403':
          description: Caller does not have access to one or more requested projects
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  /report-exports/{exportId}:
    get:
      operationId: getReportExport
      summary: Get an export's status and download link
      tags: [Reports]
      parameters:
        - name: exportId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Export details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ReportExport'
        '401':
          description: Missing or invalid credentials
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
        '404':
          description: Export not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
components:
  parameters:
    ProjectIdQuery:
      name: projectId
      in: query
      required: true
      schema: { type: string }
    FromDate:
      name: from
      in: query
      schema: { type: string, format: date }
    ToDate:
      name: to
      in: query
      schema: { type: string, format: date }
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    DashboardMetrics:
      type: object
      required: [projectId, tasksTotal, tasksByStatus, overdueCount, completionRate]
      properties:
        projectId: { type: string }
        tasksTotal: { type: integer }
        tasksByStatus:
          type: object
          properties:
            to_do: { type: integer }
            in_progress: { type: integer }
            done: { type: integer }
        overdueCount: { type: integer }
        completionRate: { type: number, format: float, description: fraction of tasks done, 0-1 }
        generatedAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    TrendPoint:
      type: object
      required: [date, created, completed]
      properties:
        date: { type: string, format: date }
        created: { type: integer }
        completed: { type: integer }
    WorkloadEntry:
      type: object
      required: [assigneeId, taskCount]
      properties:
        assigneeId: { type: string }
        taskCount: { type: integer }
        overdueCount: { type: integer }
    CreateReportExportRequest:
      type: object
      required: [projectId, format]
      properties:
        projectId:
          type: array
          items: { type: string }
        format: { type: string, enum: [csv, pdf] }
        from: { type: string, format: date }
        to: { type: string, format: date }
        status: { type: string, enum: [to_do, in_progress, done] }
        assigneeId: { type: string }
    ReportExport:
      type: object
      required: [id, format, status, createdAt]
      properties:
        id: { type: string }
        format: { type: string, enum: [csv, pdf] }
        status: { type: string, enum: [pending, ready, failed] }
        downloadUrl: { type: string, nullable: true }
        createdAt: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code: { type: integer, description: HTTP or application error code }
        message: { type: string, description: short human-readable label }
        description: { type: string, description: detailed explanation }
        moreInfo: { type: string, description: URI to documentation }
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
